nora_sales: Heads up: GovHealth wants an on-prem demo but will only accept signed USB bundles. They also asked if we can provide an option where the customer holds the root signing key and we produce payloads for them to sign. Is that feasible? cc @jake_se

jake_se: Yes that's doable. Two options: 1) we sign with our key and provide detached sig + HSM attestation; 2) we produce unsigned bundles and a signing manifest for the customer to sign with their key. Option 2 needs an offline verification workflow to validate the customer's signature on our manifest.

priya_infra: Implementation notes:
- Produce bundle with ``bundle-manifest.json`` containing file digests and metadata.
- Provide ``redwood sign-ready --export-manifest`` which outputs the manifest and instructions for airgap signing. Customer signs and returns ``manifest.sig`` which we include in the bundle.
- For emergency hotfixes we can produce a patch bundle and either: A) ask customer to sign and apply; or B) if they agreed, we sign centrally (requires customer to accept our signature policy).

elaine_sec: Security notes: customer-held key is strongest for non-repudiation inside their boundary. We should require an HSM-backed key on their side if they're demanding high assurance. Also document a reproducible verification step that validates the signer's certificate chain and checks digests.

gwen_legal: This has commercial implications. If customer holds signing keys and we don't sign, that reduces our ability to forensic audit in incident. Need to update T&Cs and an addendum describing roles/responsibilities. Also confirm who owns the SBOM and whether we can redact certain third-party PURL data for export controls.

nora_sales: Great. Can infra produce a sample "customer-signed" bundle flow for the demo? We need artifacts to show the ops team. Also pricing note: they accept quarterly bundles but want to know cost to add monthly vetted hotfixes.

jake_se: We'll create a small repo with scripts: ``export-manifest.sh``, ``verify-customer-sig.sh``, and a sample unsigned bundle. Also include a step-by-step runbook for the ops team. Deployment path: operator or static.

priya_infra: I'll drop artifacts to staging and include a README. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

elaine_sec: Telemetry must be disabled by default and any telemetry files should be locally stored and not attempt egress.

gwen_legal: I'll start drafting the addendum and the limited-liability clause. Expect a draft by Wednesday.

nora_sales: Thanks team 44d
